rows.Kwic: 若鈍根者，於無事角，力守頑空，全無孔竅，執為木偶，不知非木偶，執為墻壁，不知非墻壁

Override.AttributionNote: Extensive Record of Xisou Shaotan (希叟紹曇禪師廣錄): in his small address, Xisou Shaotan describes dull students guarding stubborn emptiness as a wooden puppet and wall without openings.
